description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY (Tacticus Firestorm Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). SELECT_SHOOTER on the ENGAGED Intercessor Squad (TACTICUS, engaged with the Gretchin; eligible for close-quarters shooting through its bolt pistols) opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a real click spends 1 CP; its ranged attacks excluding [BLAST] have [CLOSE-QUARTERS] — the bolt rifle becomes usable in close-quarters shooting (CloseQuartersShooting.weapon_allowed), a [BLAST] grenade launcher does not — and [IGNORES COVER].

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the bolt rifle has [CLOSE-QUARTERS], a [BLAST] weapon does not
the bolt rifle can now target the engaged Gretchin
the shooting panel's actions: the bolt rifle assigned at the engaged Gretchin and Confirm Targets (close-quarters shooting)
